verifications.claim: The "Arctic Frost" investigation is a Senate Judiciary Committee-led probe into a 2022 FBI inquiry regarding the 2020 election "false electors scheme".
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'the FBI targeted... as part of its Arctic Frost investigation'; R4: 'ARCTIC FROST OFFICIALLY OPENED [April 13, 2022]'
verifications.reasoning: Arctic Frost is explicitly the FBI investigation into the 2020 election 'elector case,' not a Senate-led probe; Senate oversight investigates Arctic Frost.

verifications.claim: The "Arctic Frost" investigation is led by Senator Chuck Grassley.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The FBI’s Arctic Frost investigation was opened in April 2022 by former anti-Trump agent Timothy Thibault'; R4: Grassley’s oversight started July 2022, separate from Arctic Frost opening.
verifications.reasoning: Arctic Frost is an FBI investigation opened by Timothy Thibault; Grassley leads oversight into it, not Arctic Frost itself.

verifications.claim: The "Arctic Frost" investigation alleges that the FBI and Special Counsel Jack Smith improperly targeted hundreds of Republicans, including members of Congress, via surveillance and phone record subpoenas.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: Grassley’s statement: 'Arctic Frost and related weaponization by federal law enforcement'; R4: 'Arctic Frost was the vehicle by which partisan FBI agents... could improperly investigate'
verifications.reasoning: Allegations of improper targeting are made by Grassley's oversight about Arctic Frost (FBI probe), not by Arctic Frost itself.

verifications.claim: The 2022 FBI inquiry was opened in April 2022 by the FBI.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The FBI’s Arctic Frost investigation was opened in April 2022'; R4: 'April 13, 2022: ARCTIC FROST OFFICIALLY OPENED'
verifications.reasoning: Direct match: FBI's Arctic Frost (the 2022 inquiry) opened in April 2022.

verifications.claim: The 2022 FBI inquiry was later incorporated into Special Counsel Jack Smith's case against Donald Trump.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The Arctic Frost investigation formed the basis of Jack Smith’s elector case'; R3: 'FBI’s “Arctic Frost” investigation, which formed the basis of Jack Smith’s elector case'; R4: 'Jack Smith’s failed election case... began... under the codename “Arctic Frost.”'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm Arctic Frost (2022 FBI inquiry) formed the basis/incorporated into Smith's case.

verifications.claim: The "Arctic Frost" oversight revealed the FBI and DOJ obtained records for at least nine Republican members of Congress (eight senators and one House member).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'FBI targeted eight Republican senators’ personal cell phones... One Republican member of the House... The FBI targeted the following Members of Congress: [lists 8 senators, Rep. Mike Kelly]'
verifications.reasoning: Exact match: Grassley's oversight revealed records for exactly nine (eight senators, one House member).

verifications.claim: Over 400 Republican-affiliated organizations and individuals were reportedly targeted, according to Senator Chuck Grassley.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'hundreds of Republicans were targeted as part of the Arctic Frost investigation – including over a dozen members of Congress and 400+ Republican organizations and individuals'
verifications.reasoning: Grassley's oversight reports exactly '400+ Republican organizations and individuals' targeted.

verifications.claim: Senator Grassley and Senator Ron Johnson are conducting an investigation into the FBI’s actions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Grassley’s oversight'; R3: 'Grassley, Johnson... oversight of the FBI’s “Arctic Frost” investigation'; R4: 'Chairman Grassley’s oversight'; R7: 'Grassley and Johnson... demanding... records'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm Grassley and Johnson jointly investigating FBI actions in Arctic Frost.

verifications.claim: Senator Grassley and Senator Ron Johnson aim to release records and hold hearings in 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Senate Judiciary Committee Plans Series of Arctic Frost Hearings for 2026'; R10: 'Senate Judiciary Committee... plans to hold a series of hearings... in 2026... Grassley is conducting oversight... in partnership with... Ron Johnson'
verifications.reasoning: Sources detail Grassley (with Johnson) planning 2026 hearings and record releases on Arctic Frost.

verifications.claim: "Arctic-FROST" is a separate, unrelated research project focused on Arctic sustainability based at the University of Northern Iowa.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Arctic-FROST: Arctic FRontiers Of SusTainability... University of Northern Iowa... sustainability science research in the Arctic'
verifications.reasoning: Exact match: R1 describes Arctic-FROST as a UNI-based Arctic sustainability project, distinct from FBI's Arctic Frost.
